ud5.5:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbārāme migāramātupāsāde.
ud5.5:1.3: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tadahuposathe bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto nisinno hoti.
ud5.5:2.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante paṭhame yāme uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud5.5:2.2: “abhikkantā bhante, ratti. nikkhanto paṭhamo yāmo. ciranisinno bhikkhusaṅgho.
ud5.5:3.1: dutiyampi kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante majjhime yāme, uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud5.5:3.2: “abhikkantā bhante ratti. nikkhanto majjhimo yāmo. ciranisinno bhikkhusaṅgho.
ud5.5:4.1: tatiyampi kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante pacchime yāme uddhaṭe aruṇe nandimukhiyā rattiyā uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ cīvaraṃ katvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud5.5:4.2: “abhikkantā bhante ratti. nikkhanto pacchimo yāmo. uddhaṭo aruṇo, nandimukhī ratti. ciranisinno bhikkhusaṅgho.
ud5.5:5.2: “kaṃ nu kho bhagavā puggalaṃ sandhāya evamāha:
ud5.5:5.4: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno sabbāvantaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ cetasā ceto paricca manasākāsi.
ud5.5:5.5: addasā kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ dussīlaṃ pāpadhammaṃ asucisaṅkassarasamācāraṃ paṭicchannakammantaṃ assamaṇaṃ samaṇapaṭiññaṃ abrahmacāriṃ brahmacārīpaṭiññaṃ antopūtiṃ avassutaṃ kasambujātaṃ majjhe bhikkhusaṅghassa nisinnaṃ.
ud5.5:5.6: disvāna uṭṭhāyāsanā yena so puggalo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā taṃpuggalaṃ etadavoca:
ud5.5:5.9: atha kho so puggalo tuṇhī ahosi.
ud5.5:6.1: dutiyampi kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ etadavoca:
ud5.5:6.4: dutiyampi kho so puggalo tuṇhī ahosi. tatiyampi kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ etadavoca: “uṭṭhehāvuso, diṭṭhosi bhagavatā. natthi te bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvāso’ti.
ud5.5:6.5: tatiyampi kho so puggalo tuṇhī ahosi.
ud5.5:7.1: atha kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā bahidvārakoṭṭhakā nikkhāmetvā sūcighakaṃ datvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
ud5.5:7.6: yāva bāhā gahaṇāpi nāma so moghapuriso āgamessatī”ti.
ud5.5:8.2: “na dānāhaṃ bhikkhave, itoparaṃ uposathaṃ karissāmi pātimokkhaṃ uddisissāmi.
ud5.5:8.3: tumheva dāni bhikkhave itoparaṃ uposathaṃ kareyyātha, pātimokkhaṃ uddiseyyātha.
ud5.5:8.4: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso, yaṃ tathāgato aparisuddhāya parisāya uposathaṃ kareyya, pātimokkhaṃ uddiseyya.”
ud5.5:9.1: aṭṭhime, bhikkhave, mahāsamudde acchariyā abbhutā dhammā, ye disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
ud5.5:10.1: mahāsamuddo bhikkhave, anupubbaninno, anupubbapoṇo, anupubbapabbhāro, nāyatakeneva papāto.
ud5.5:10.2: yaṃ bhikkhave mahāsamuddo anupubbaninno, anupubbapoṇo, anupubbapabbhāro, nāyatakeneva papāto.
ud5.5:10.3: ayaṃ bhikkhave, mahāsamudde paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti. (2.)
ud5.5:11.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, mahāsamuddo ṭhitadhammo velaṃ nātivattati.
ud5.5:11.2: yaṃ bhikkhave, mahāsamuddo ṭhitadhammo velaṃ nātivattati.
ud5.5:11.3: ayampi bhikkhave mahāsamudde dutiyo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti. (3.)
ud5.5:12.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, mahāsamuddo na matena kuṇapena saṃvasati. yaṃ yaṃ hoti mahāsamudde mataṃ kuṇapaṃ, taṃ khippaññeva tīraṃ vāheti, thalaṃ ussādeti.
ud5.5:12.2: yaṃ bhikkhave mahāsamuddo na matena kuṇapena saṃvasati, yaṃ hoti mahāsamudde mataṃ kuṇapaṃ, taṃ khippaññeva tīraṃ vāheti, thalaṃ ussādeti.

ud5.5:13.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, yā kāci mahānadiyo, seyyathidaṃ: gaṅgā, yamunā, aciravatī, sarabhū, mahī. tā mahāsamuddaṃ patvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni, mahāsamuddotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchanti.
ud5.5:13.2: yaṃ bhikkhave, yā kāci mahānadiyo, seyyathidaṃ: gaṅgā, yamunā, aciravatī, sarabhū, mahī. tā mahāsamuddaṃ patvā jahanti purimāni nāmagottāni, mahāsamuddotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchanti.

ud5.5:14.2: yaṃ bhikkhave, yā ca loke savantiyo mahāsamuddaṃ appenti, yā ca antaḷikkhā dhārā papatanti, na tena mahāsammuddassa ūnattaṃ vā pūrattaṃ vā paññāyati.

ud5.5:15.3: ayampi bhikkhave, mahāsamudde chaṭṭho acchariyo abbhutadhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti. (7.)

ud5.5:17.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, mahāsamuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso. tatrime bhūtā: timi, timiṅgalo, timirapiṅgalo, asurā, nāgā, gandhabbā. santi mahāsamudde yojanasatikāpi attabhāvā, dviyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā, tiyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā, catuyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā, pañcayojanasatikāpi attabhāvā.
ud5.5:17.2: yaṃ bhikkhave, mahāsamuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso. tatrime bhūtā: timi, timiṅgalo, timirapiṅgalo, asurā, nāgā, gandhabbā. santi mahāsamudde yojanasatikāpi attabhāvā, dviyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā, tiyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā, catuyojanasatikāpi attabhāvā, pañcayojanasatikāpi attabhāvā.
ud5.5:17.3: ayampi bhikkhave, mahāsamudde aṭṭhamo acchariyo abbhutadhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
ud5.5:17.4: ime kho bhikkhave, mahāsamudde aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutadhammā ye disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.

ud5.5:27.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
